crossRefs.note: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,
One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
crossRefs.keyword: a secret to another. or, the secret of another

crossRefs.note: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
crossRefs.keyword: a secret to another. or, the secret of another

translations.web: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,
translations.bsb: Argue your case with your neighbor without betraying another’s confidence,
translations.kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
translations.asv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbor himself, And disclose not the secret of another;
